before_captions:
WEBVTT

00:00:00.000 --> 00:00:01.880
I paid the minimum, why is my

00:00:01.880 --> 00:00:04.160
balance still auditioning for a horror movie?

00:00:05.540 --> 00:00:08.140
The minimum is the required payment, not

00:00:08.140 --> 00:00:11.920
a promise that interest disappears. Paying more

00:00:11.920 --> 00:00:13.540
than the minimum can cut interest costs

00:00:13.540 --> 00:00:16.740
and help you finish sooner. So the

00:00:16.740 --> 00:00:18.660
tiny number on my statement is not

00:00:18.660 --> 00:00:21.980
the finish line. If your card offers

00:00:21.980 --> 00:00:24.020
a grace period and you are not

00:00:24.020 --> 00:00:26.820
carrying a balance, paying in full by

00:00:26.820 --> 00:00:28.840
the due date can avoid interest on

00:00:28.840 --> 00:00:32.200
new purchases. Check your statement and agreement.

00:00:32.960 --> 00:00:34.480
Minimum due and paid in full are

00:00:34.480 --> 00:00:35.020
different goals.
